issues.issue: Did the RAD err in finding Islamabad offers a viable Internal Flight Alternative (IFA)?
issues.applicant_position: RAD's IFA finding speculative, incomplete, failed to assess full factors, assailants could track Applicant.
issues.respondent_position: RAD correctly applied IFA test; no evidence of persecution risk in Islamabad; Applicant failed to prove otherwise.
issues.result_text: Court finds RAD's IFA findings reasonable and will not disturb them.

issues.issue: Did the RAD err in its second prong analysis of the IFA test by failing to address a full range of factors (transportation, language, education, accommodation, religion, indigenous status, healthcare)?
issues.applicant_position: RAD failed to address full range of factors; omission unjustified; challenges RPD's incomplete analysis on state protection.
issues.respondent_position: RAD need not address uncontested factors; no evidence RAD's determination unreasonable; burden on Applicant to prove hardship.
issues.result_text: Court rejects argument; burden on Applicant; no new issues at judicial review; no evidence of undue hardship in IFA.
